MonoBrowser Mobile 0.2.4

Media
- Muted autoplay videos (background loops, ads, banners, feed previews) no longer show a media notification or open picture in picture when you leave the app. A video you have heard still counts after you mute it
- When a page stops playing right after it started, Android no longer keeps an empty player card (only the channel name) in the system media controls (lock screen, quick settings on HyperOS / One UI)

Install: download `MonoBrowser-0.2.4.apk`, open it and allow installing from your browser/file manager when Android asks. If Google Play Protect asks to scan the app, choose "Scan app". Optionally verify it against `MonoBrowser-0.2.4.apk.sha256` (`sha256sum -c`).
Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Updating from 0.2.3 keeps your tabs, bookmarks and settings; 0.2.3 also offers the update in the app.

Downloads:
- Android: `MonoBrowser-0.2.4.apk` (+ `MonoBrowser-0.2.4.apk.sha256`)
